name: MarkdownClearancePlanner
tagline: Find the aged stock, pick the right markdown step and see the margin impact before you cut the price.
description: A complete markdown and clearance planning app for Power Apps and Power Pages: track aged stock and sell-through per SKU and location, compare weeks of cover with the exit date, follow a price ladder with cadence rules and price endings, run elasticity-based what-ifs of sell-through, residual stock and margin per step, propose and approve markdowns within director thresholds and a markdown budget, put prices live and export the POS price file – with an aging matrix, kanban board and markdown calendar.
features: Markdown ladder (% off full price) with price-ending rules
Cadence rule – minimum weeks between markdowns
Elasticity-based projection of sell-through, residual stock and margin to the exit date
Recommendation engine picks the shallowest step that hits the target sell-through (never below cost unless allowed)
Director approval above a depth threshold and for below-cost prices
Markdown budget with committed vs proposed
Exit routes (outlet, jobber, return to vendor, donate)
Demo mode with a fictional fashion and home retailer
Phone card list and bottom view switcher
